rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for a disposable paper or lightweight carton, such as one for milk or eggs.

example.english: This carton contains milk, so be careful when carrying it.
example.traditional: 呢個紙盒裝住牛奶，拎嗰陣小心啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zi2 hap6 zong1 zyu6 ngau4 naai5 ling1 go2 zan6 siu2 sam1 di1

rows.note: Use this for the cigarette-pack sense rather than for a food or drink carton.

example.english: I forgot to bring my cigarette carton, so I need to ask you to lend me a cigarette.
example.traditional: 我唔記得帶煙包，要問你借支煙喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 jin1 baau1 jiu3 man6 nei5 ze3 zi1 jin1 laa3
